source_record_binding.scope_semantics: The canonical artifact is the operational-gap source record in rafaelmeloreisnovo/Mapa, not the external/runtime/scientific subject described by that record.
source_record_binding.known_rule: Use source evidence_for/proven_scoped when present; otherwise assert only source-record presence at exact source_refs.
source_record_binding.unknown_rule: Always preserve that subject-level closure is unproven until evidence_required is satisfied.
source_record_binding.authority_rule: Use explicit owner/owner_authority/authority values when present; otherwise Mapa control_plane governance.
source_record_binding.evidence_required_rule: Union all evidence_needed values; if absent, use closure/next-gate evidence; never infer external success.
source_record_binding.next_gate_rule: Use exact next_probe/next_verifiable_step/next_review_gate/closure_gate evidence; fallback only to governed evidence review.
source_record_binding.source_refs_rule: Exact source_paths plus this policy path.
